_comment: Cash in the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund. OPMCM PMDRF, 28 Bhadra 17:00 — nine-bank NPR stock Rs 9,995,024,994 (MoF published total). Pre-flood Rs 2,082,422,405; net post-flood that closes with this stock Rs 7,912,602,589. Published gross post-flood collections Rs 8,912,602,589 before the Rs 1 billion release. Nine bank rows on the bulletin sum to Rs 9,725,289,993 (Rs 269,735,001 below the published MoF total — headline carries the MoF figure). USD 23,441,854 @ 152.59; total-available label Rs 13,572,017,563. Name-transfer, NCHL, PhonePe, foreign pledges, in-kind and IFRC are not this bank stock.

breakdowns.caption_en: Nine-bank NPR stock Rs 9.99 billion (OPMCM PMDRF, 28 Bhadra 17:00). Pre-flood Rs 2,082,422,405; net post-flood Rs 7,912,602,589. Gross post-flood collections Rs 8,912,602,589 before the Rs 1 billion release. Bank rows sum to Rs 9,725,289,993; headline uses the published MoF total. USD separate; total-available label Rs 13.57 billion.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The Rs 2.08 billion already in the fund is inside the 9.99 billion, not on top of it. USD 23.44 million is not part of the Nepali-rupee total; the 'total available' label Rs 13,572,017,563 is NPR stock plus USD equivalent — not a second cash pile. Name-transfer, NCHL, PhonePe, foreign pledges, World Bank and IFRC are not this bank stock.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: विपद्अघिको मौज्दात ९.९९ अर्बभित्र छ, माथि होइन। डलर नेपाली जम्मामा होइन। नाम-हस्तान्तरण, NCHL, फोनपे, वैदेशिक घोषणा, विश्व बैंक र आईएफआरसी यो बैंक मौज्दात होइनन्।

aside.label_en: Total available label (NPR stock + USD equivalent)
Published gross post-flood collections (before Rs 1bn release)

breakdowns.caption_en: UK $6.79m + US $3.6m + OCHA $3.2m + South Korea $1m + ADB $5m + UAE $10m + Jensen Huang $10m. These are pledges and contributions announced outside the published rupee balance, not cash counted in the Prime Minister's fund table.
breakdowns.caption_ne: बेलायत $६.७९ मि. + अमेरिका $३.६ मि. + ओसीएचए $३.२ मि. + दक्षिण कोरिया $१ मि. + एडीबी $५ मि. + युएई $१० मि. + जेन्सेन ह्वाङ $१० मि.। यी प्रकाशित रुपैयाँ मौज्दातबाहिरका घोषणा/योगदान हुन्, कोषको तालिकामा गनिएको नगद होइनन्।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: Not added to the Rs 9.99 billion. World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC CHF 25 million appeal are separate lines, not inside this $39.59 million. ADB $5m and UAE $10m are pledges, not cash received. UAE's 83-tonne flight is inside the $10m package, not on top of it. Jensen Huang's $10m (about Rs 1.51 billion) is a contribution to the Prime Minister's fund that the published rupee balance does not yet carry — count it once, here.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: रु. ९ अर्ब ९९ करोडमा जोडिँदैन। विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी CHF २५ मिलियन अपिल यो $३९.५९ मिलियनभित्र होइनन्। एडीबी $५ मिलियन र युएई $१० मिलियन घोषणा हुन्, आएको नगद होइनन्। युएईको ८३ टन उडान $१० मिलियनभित्र छ, माथि होइन। जेन्सेन ह्वाङको $१० मिलियन (करिब रु. १.५१ अर्ब) प्रधानमन्त्री कोषमा गएको योगदान हो जुन प्रकाशित रुपैयाँ मौज्दातले अझै समेटेको छैन — एक पटक, यहीँ गन्नुहोस्।

exclusive.detail_en: OPMCM, 16 Bhadra — Rs 1 billion released. The 28 Bhadra MoF bank stock of Rs 9.99 billion is after that release.

exclusive.label_en: Rs 13.5 crore released to 15 local levels
exclusive.detail_en: NDRRMA — from the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund to 15 local levels in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Tanahun, covering 55 wards. Two tranches of Rs 6.75 crore: the first went out on 28 August, the second is being released now. The earlier MoHA 6.75 crore line is the first tranche inside this 13.5 crore — count once.
exclusive.detail_ne: एनडीआरआरएमए — प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोषबाट रसुवा, नुवाकोट, धादिङ, गोरखा र तनहुँका १५ स्थानीय तहका ५५ वडालाई। ६ करोड ७५ लाखका दुई किस्ता: पहिलो २८ अगस्टमा निकासा भयो, दोस्रो अहिले निकासा हुँदैछ। गृहको अघिल्लो ६.७५ करोड पहिलो किस्ता हो, यही १३.५ करोडभित्र — एक पटक मात्र गन्नुहोस्।
